verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships an official Mail MCP server that lets AI assistants read, summarize, draft and send emails, schedule meetings, check read status and manage multiple accounts. That is a real programmatic surface, but it covers only a subset of UI features. Probes found no public REST/OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API, evidence of parity for UI features like Auto Labels/Split Inbox/Snippets/team comments/calendar settings, an API reference, and independent corroboration that MCP actions match UI capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools. You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail, or edit and send directly from your AI assistant.
